messages:
sec-bot: ALERT: 03/20/2026 09:12:34 UTC — Automated detection: IAM role 'data-pipeline-exec' has a trust policy with wildcard principal and S3 bucket 'redwood-data-staging' has public ACLs. Severity: HIGH. Console: https://console.aws.amazon.com/alerts/ABC123 :rotating_light:
arya: oncall? I saw the alert, assigning to ben if he's free.
ben: I got it, I'm oncall. grabbing details now. which account/region?
maria: this is prod-account us-west-2 (pipeline infra). I see the bucket in the infra account.
ben: checking role trust policy -> confirms: "{\"Version\":\"2012-10-17\",\"Statement\":[{\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Principal\":{\"AWS\":\"*\"},\"Action\":\"sts:AssumeRole\"}]}".
ben: S3 ACLs: bucket ACL shows PUBLIC_READ, several objects inherited. PublicAccessBlock is OFF.
arya: initial containment: block public access and remove ACLs, and lock down assume-role. ben please run fixes and paste commands.
ben: doing immediate changes now — documenting commands here:
```
# block public access on bucket
aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket redwood-data-staging --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true --profile prod
# make bucket private
aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-data-staging --acl private --profile prod
# remove public ACLs from objects (fast sweep)
aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-data-staging --query 'Contents[].Key' --profile prod | jq -r '.[]' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws s3api put-object-acl --bucket redwood-data-staging --key '{}' --acl private --profile prod
# update trust policy to restrict to pipeline role principal
cat > /tmp/trust-patch.json <<'POL'
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pipeline-runner"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}
POL
aws iam update-assume-role-policy --role-name data-pipeline-exec --policy-document file:///tmp/trust-patch.json --profile prod
```
ben: ran the public access block + bucket ACL change. object sweep queued, some objects updated already. trust policy patched to explicit principal.
maria: good. next: check KMS key used by the bucket (alias/redwood-data-key) for any grants to that role or to external principals.
ben: running `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/redwood-data-key --profile prod` now. found one grant to arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/thirdparty-ingest (suspicious).
arya: revoke any unnecessary grants and rotate key material if there are external grants. Ben, revoke then rotate via schedule.
ben: commands:
```
aws kms retire-grant --grant-id <grant-id> --key-id alias/redwood-data-key --profile prod
# schedule key rotation / create new CMK and reencrypt bucket objects via S3 copy if needed
```
ben: retired the external grant (grant-id=G-XYZ). Created ticket to rotate CMK: INC-4589.
samir: do we know if any GET/GETOBJECTs happened from outside accounts while ACLs were public?
ben: querying CloudTrail and S3 access logs. quick grep shows ~12 GetObject requests from 52.15.200.45 (IP is external) between 08:50-09:05 UTC. pulling object list.
arya: treat as potential data exfil — start containment + preserve logs. Maria, ensure CloudTrail logs and S3 access logs are archived to compliance bucket and set to immutable retention.
maria: enabling log archiving and set retention. command:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-data-staging/s3-access-logs/ s3://redwood-logs-archive/forensic/redwood-data-staging/ --recursive --profile prod
```
cleo: please @me when you have initial customer-impact assessment. compliance wants list of objects touched and whether any PII present.
ben: pulling object metadata now; initial sample looks like pipeline intermediate csvs with internal IDs. not obvious PII but continuing scan with DLP quick-check.
arya: good. next steps: 1) containment done (ACL + public block + trust policy restricted + revoke external KMS grant). 2) forensics: CloudTrail + S3 access logs preserved, list of GetObject events exported. 3) rotate CMK (ticket INC-4589), rotate any long-lived credentials associated with the role. 4) postmortem + alerts.
ben: I've detached role from running EC2 instance profiles that were using it to be safe. flagged several ECS tasks to restart with updated IAM.
maria: confirming infra change: terraform state had a manual override that allowed wildcard in trust policy (found in module pipeline/assume-role). I'll open a terraform PR to fix module and add a guardian policy check.
arya: assign owners: ben (containment + forensics), maria (infra/Terraform fix + deploy), cleo (compliance + customer comms if needed), samir (product assessment — does this affect SLA/data contracts?).
samir: I'll assess whether any customer contracts require disclosure. ping me when list of objects is ready.
ben: forensics ETA 60m, exporting object list and GetObject events to /tmp/forensics_redwood-data-staging.tar.gz and uploading to secure evidence bucket.
maria: adding automated guardrail: add a policy in org SCP/guard that denies iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy with Principal:"*" and an AWS Config rule for S3 public ACLs. PR will include tests.
cleo: compliance request: preserve all diffs and timeline. add incident label and severity summary. I'll draft initial incident notification template if we need to alert customers.
arya: quick comms note for now: "Internal: detected and contained misconfig that allowed public access to staging bucket and overly-broad role trust. No confirmed PII exfiltration; forensics in progress. More updates in this thread." Keep external comms on hold until forensics. :lock:
ben: posted upload of artifacts to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-4589/ and created timeline doc.
arya: after-action items (short):
- terraform module fix + PR (maria)
- add org guardrail + AWS Config rule (maria)
- rotate CMK + reencrypt important objects (ben/maria)
- rotate any service credentials/instance profiles (ben)
- add monitoring rule to detect wildcard principals in trust policies (arya)
- run DLP scan on objects accessed (cleo)
- postmortem within 72 hours (owner: arya)
cleo: noted, will coordinate DLP and compliance write-up.
ben: will follow up with timeline export and initial findings by 10:30 UTC.
arya: thanks team. mark as contained for now but keep thread updated if new findings show data access or further lateral movement. :white_check_mark:
